mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, overall_score, result, summary, strengths, weaknesses, suggestions, llm_model, prompt_version, created_at, updated_at FROM interview_report WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_report( session_id, overall_score, result, summary, strengths, weaknesses, suggestions, llm_model, prompt_version ) VALUES( #{sessionId}, #{overallScore}, #{result}, #{summary}, #{strengths}, #{weaknesses}, #{suggestions}, #{llmModel}, #{promptVersion} )
